title: Multi-agent attacks — tampering & rogue agents
summary: Module 3. When planner, executor, and reviewer pass messages, the messages themselves become the attack surface. Tamper an unsigned plan in transit and smuggle a rogue tool, then sign messages and allow-list agents.
takeaway: Between agents, trust must be authenticated. An unsigned message is an unauthenticated instruction.
design_rule: Sign inter-agent messages and verify before acting; allow-list every agent and tool.
